label: Mob Farmer
tooltip: Which enemies to farm, where, and how to pull them.

should_handle_targeting.label: Auto-target enemies
should_handle_targeting.tooltip: BOCCHI picks the targets while pulling. Once the fight starts, your combat plugin picks them.

force_target_central_enemy.label: Prefer the middle of the pack
force_target_central_enemy.tooltip: Target the enemy in the middle of the pack, not the closest one. Only used when you fight without a combat plugin.

consider_special_mobs.label: Include special enemies
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Also pull enemies that only appear in certain weather or at certain times.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count specials toward minimums
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip:
On: special enemies count towards the minimums below.
Off: they are still pulled, but don't count.

max_euclidean_distance.label: Max pull range
max_euclidean_distance.tooltip: Enemies farther away than this are ignored.

spots.label: Farm spots
spots.tooltip:
Your saved farm spots. BOCCHI starts at the enabled spot with the highest priority (the closest one on a tie). With no spots, it farms where you are standing.
A stack point is where the pack is gathered, useful in caves.
spots.empty: No spots yet. BOCCHI farms where you are standing.
spots.name: Name

claimed_spot_seconds.label: Leave if claimed after (seconds)
claimed_spot_seconds.tooltip: If other players keep claiming the enemies or stand on your spot for this long, BOCCHI treats the spot as claimed and moves to the next one until you restart.

claimed_player_radius.label: Claimed player radius (yalms)
claimed_player_radius.tooltip: How close another player has to stay to your farm spot before it counts as claimed.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Walk back if farther than (yalms)
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After a fight, only walk back to the farm spot if you ended up farther away than this.

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to spot after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Walk back to the farm spot when combat ends. With no spots, that is where you pressed Start.

render_debug_lines.label: Show debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: While farming, draw red lines to enemies BOCCHI can pull and green lines to enemies you are fighting.

apply_battle_bell.label: Use Battle Bell
apply_battle_bell.tooltip: Before each pull, switch to Geomancer, use Battle Bell, then switch back.

apply_ringing_respite.label: Use Ringing Respite
apply_ringing_respite.tooltip: Before each pull, use Ringing Respite, which heals you when you are hit. Needs Geomancer level 3.

apply_quickstep.label: Use Quickstep
apply_quickstep.tooltip: Before each pull, use the Phantom Dancer's Quickstep to dodge attacks for 90 seconds. Needs Dancer level 2.

apply_counterstance.label: Use Counterstance
apply_counterstance.tooltip: Just before the pull, use the Phantom Monk's Counterstance. Needs Monk level 3.

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Longest wait for a buff (seconds)
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: If Battle Bell, Ringing Respite or Counterstance is on cooldown for longer than this, pull without it.

quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.label: Skip Quickstep if Quicker Step has (minutes left)
quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.tooltip: Don't use Quickstep while your Quicker Step crystal buff still has at least this many minutes left. 0 = use it every pull.

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum enemies before fighting
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip: How many enemies to gather before the fight starts. A farm spot can have its own number.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Gather timeout (seconds)
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip: After this long, start fighting with whatever has been gathered.

use_ranged_pull.label: Ranged pull (tanks)
use_ranged_pull.tooltip: Tanks pull with their ranged attack and don't walk up to each enemy.

yield_to_pots.label: Stop for Magic Pots
yield_to_pots.tooltip: Stop farming for a Magic Pot that is up or about to appear, then come back. How early to leave is set on the Pot timing page.

cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.label: Cast Treasure Sight at the farm spot
cast_treasure_sight_at_farm.tooltip: Every so often, cast Treasure Sight at your farm spot to see how many coffers are left, then keep farming. Needs Freelancer level 10.

yield_to_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure Hunt on a timer
yield_to_treasure_hunt.tooltip: Every so often, stop farming and go on a treasure hunt if enough coffers are left, then come back. How many is enough is set on the Treasure Hunter page. Needs a recent Treasure Sight.

treasure_hunt_prefer_pots.label: Prioritize pots during timed hunt
treasure_hunt_prefer_pots.tooltip:
On: a Magic Pot also interrupts the treasure hunt.
Off: the hunt runs to the end, even when a pot appears.

yield_to_crystal_buffs.label: Refresh crystal buffs when low
yield_to_crystal_buffs.tooltip: Stop farming to refresh your knowledge crystal buffs when they run low. Needs Automate buffs on the Buffs page.
